    <style>
      /* Demo scaffolding only: the paper, a mono label per row, and rows. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
      }
      .demo {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x5);
        background-color: var(--sem-color-ground);
        background-image: var(--sem-texture-grain);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .demo + .demo {
        border-top: var(--sem-rule-double) double var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .demo__head {
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x3);
        padding-bottom: var(--sem-space-x1);
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-heavy) solid var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-display);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-lead);
      }
      .demo__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x4) 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-eyebrow);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-eyebrow);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-eyebrow);
        letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-eyebrow);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .demo__row {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
      }
      .demo__map {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea-3);
      }
      /* Demo content only: what a Surface holds over the map. */
      .demo__stack {
        display: grid;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x4);
      }
      .demo__kick {
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-eyebrow);

        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-eyebrow);
        letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-eyebrow);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .demo__spot {
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x3);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x2) 0;
        border-top: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .demo__name {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-display);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
        font-style: italic;

      .demo__fig {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
    </style>
  </head>

A box to write a few sentences in (ui/TextArea.tsx, controlStyles({ kind: "area" })): the text input's box, three large controls tall, growing downward.

Anatomy

  • Box: .wf-control.wf-control--area — the shared field box (hairline in sem.color.line-strong, sem.radius.control, sem.color.card, sem.space.x3 across), its contents held to the top instead of the middle.
  • Element: .wf-control__input on a <textarea> — at least sem.space.step × 34.5 tall (138, three large controls) before anything is written, sem.space.x3 above and below the words, Newsreader at sem.font.size.prose on sem.font.line.normal, resizable vertically only.
  • Shared: the box, the element and every state are the .wf-control classes owned by components/text-input/component.css (the product's controlStyles in ui/control.ts). This component links that file and adds only .wf-control--area.

Variants

  • One kind. A text area is never a filter, so it is never --active.

States

  • Hover: the border goes to sem.color.ink (.is-hover in the demo).
  • Focus: the one ring round the box (:focus-within, .is-focus in the demo): sem.ring.width of sem.color.focus, sem.ring.offset clear.
  • Invalid: sem.color.warn border on sem.color.warn-ground, from aria-invalid="true" or a Field carrying data-invalid.
  • Disabled: sem.color.sunken, a sem.color.line border, sem.color.ink-disabled text.
  • Placeholder: italic, sem.color.ink-muted.
  • Coarse pointer: the text steps to sem.font.size.input (16); the leading stays normal.

Usage

  • Inside a Field, for a note, a listing's description, a post: sentences, not figures.
  • A placeholder asks the question ("What was it like?"); it is not the label.
  • Keep the words few; a figure belongs in a text input beside it.

Accessibility

  • A real <textarea>, named by its Field's <label for> or aria-label.
  • Invalid sets aria-invalid="true"; the Field's message carries role="alert".
  • The resize handle is the platform's, and vertical only, so a reader can give themselves room without breaking the column.
components/text-area/component.css
/* Text area — ui/TextArea.tsx, controlStyles({ kind: "area" }), rendered in
 * CSS. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * The box, the element and every state (hover, ring, invalid, disabled,
 * placeholder, the coarse pointer's 16) are the shared `.wf-control` classes
 * in ../text-input/component.css, which the page links first. This file adds
 * only what the area kind adds. */

/* The words start at the top of the box, not its middle. */
.wf-control--area {
  align-items: flex-start;
}

/* Three large controls tall before anything is written, as the design bundle
 * always drew a text area; it grows downward only, and reads at the normal
 * leading, which the coarse pointer's input step does not override. */
.wf-control--area .wf-control__input {
  min-height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 34.5);
  padding-block: var(--sem-space-x3);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-normal);
  resize: vertical;
}

A box to write in (ui/TextInput.tsx over ui/control.ts, controlStyles). Body-face text, an italic placeholder, a hairline box ruled at the stroke's 3:1, square but for the field's 2px.

Anatomy

  • Box: .wf-control (the box slot) — at least sem.size.touch tall, sem.space.x3 across, sem.space.x2 between its parts, a sem.rule.hairline border in sem.color.line-strong, sem.radius.control, sem.color.card. The box is what is drawn: it takes the border, the hover and the ring, so a prefix sits inside the same outline as the text.
  • Element: .wf-control__input (the input slot) — bare, no border, no fill, no ring of its own; Newsreader at sem.font.size.prose, normal weight, in the box's ink.
  • Optional prefix: .wf-control__adornment — a currency sign or a unit, a figure's companion, so IBM Plex Mono at sem.font.size.caption in sem.color.ink-muted.
  • Shared: this file owns .wf-control, .wf-control__input, .wf-control__adornment and .wf-control--active for all three field controls, as controlStyles does in the product. Text area and select link ../text-input/component.css and add only --area and --select in their own files.

Variants

  • Text (the default) — one line, an optional prefix.
  • Active (.wf-control--active) — a filter that is narrowing the results, as opposed to sitting at "any": the border in sem.color.accent.primary and a second hairline inside it (an inset ring), so it is not said by colour alone. A line, not a fill, so it never rivals the one filled action.

States

  • Hover: the border goes to sem.color.ink (.is-hover holds it in the demo); an active box keeps its accent.
  • Focus: the box draws the one ring when its element holds the focus (:focus-within, .is-focus in the demo): sem.ring.width of sem.color.focus, sem.ring.offset clear.
  • Invalid: sem.color.warn border on sem.color.warn-ground, reached by aria-invalid="true" on the element or by a Field carrying data-invalid. The Field's message says what is wrong in words.
  • Disabled: sem.color.sunken ground, sem.color.line border, sem.color.ink-disabled text, default cursor; hover changes nothing.
  • Placeholder: italic, sem.color.ink-muted, full opacity.
  • Coarse pointer: the text steps to sem.font.size.input (16) so a phone does not zoom the page when the field takes the focus.

Usage

  • Always inside a Field, which names it in the mono label.
  • A placeholder is an example ("Rusheen Bay, Galway"), never the label.
  • Use the prefix for a currency or a unit, so the figure stays a figure.
  • Active only on a filter; a form field is never active.

Accessibility

  • The element is a real <input>, named by its Field's <label for> or by aria-label.
  • Invalid sets aria-invalid="true" on the element; the Field announces the message with role="alert".
  • The ring is on the box, so a prefix is inside what the focus outlines.
  • Contrast: the box's line-strong is 3.7:1 on paper (a stroke); placeholder ink-muted 5.8:1 on paper. A disabled field's ink-disabled is below the words' floor on purpose: it is not there to be read.
components/text-input/component.css
/* Text input — ui/TextInput.tsx over ui/control.ts (controlStyles), rendered in
 * CSS. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * This file owns the box every field control shares: `.wf-control` (the box,
 * controlStyles' `box` slot), `.wf-control__input` (the bare element inside)
 * and `.wf-control__adornment` (a currency sign, a unit, a chevron), with the
 * `--active` filter state. Text area (`--area`) and select (`--select`) link
 * this file and add only what their kind adds.
 *
 * The box is what is drawn: it takes the border, the hover and the ring, so a
 * prefix or a chevron sits inside the same outline as the text.
 *
 * `.is-hover` and `.is-focus` hold a state still for the catalog; the product
 * reaches the same rules through :hover and :focus-within. */

/* ---- the box: a box to write in, ruled at the stroke's 3:1 ---- */
.wf-control {
  display: flex;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: var(--sem-size-touch);
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
  padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x3);
  border: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--sem-radius-control);
  background: var(--sem-color-card);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, outline-color;
  transition-duration: var(--sem-duration-fast);
}

/* Inked under the pointer. */
.wf-control:hover,
.wf-control.is-hover {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-ink);
}

/* The one ring, on the box whose field holds the focus (RING_WITHIN). */
.wf-control:focus-within,
.wf-control.is-focus {
  outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
  outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
}

/* ---- active: a filter that is narrowing the results, not sitting at "any".
 * A second line inside the border (inset-ring), so not colour alone. ---- */
.wf-control--active,
.wf-control--active:hover,
.wf-control--active.is-hover {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-accent-primary);
}
.wf-control--active {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--sem-rule-hairline) var(--sem-color-accent-primary);
}

/* ---- invalid: the warm ground. Wrong is also said by the Field's message.
 * Reached from a Field with data-invalid (group-data-invalid/field) or from
 * aria-invalid on the element itself (has-aria-invalid). ---- */
.wf-field[data-invalid] .wf-control,
.wf-field[data-invalid] .wf-control:hover,
.wf-control:has([aria-invalid="true"]),
.wf-control:has([aria-invalid="true"]):hover {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-warn);
  background: var(--sem-color-warn-ground);
}

/* ---- disabled: the second sheet, the line, and the disabled ink ---- */
.wf-control:has(:disabled),
.wf-control:has(:disabled):hover {
  border-color: var(--sem-color-line);
  background: var(--sem-color-sunken);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-disabled);
}

/* ---- the element inside: bare, it takes the box's ink ---- */
.wf-control__input {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1 1 0%;
  align-self: stretch;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
}
.wf-control__input::placeholder {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-style: italic;
  opacity: 1;
}
.wf-control__input:disabled {
  cursor: default;
}
/* The box draws the ring; the element draws none (NO_RING). */
.wf-control__input:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
}

/* A focused field under 16px makes a phone zoom the page, so on a touch
 * device a field takes the input step, which is 16. */
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .wf-control__input {
    font-size: var(--sem-font-size-input);
    line-height: var(--sem-font-line-input);
  }
}

/* ---- adornment: a unit or a currency sign, a figure's companion, so the
 * figures' face ---- */
.wf-control__adornment {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
}

Tide label

Tide label

The turn, beside its mark

Tide label · night chart (proposed)

Low tide 13:25 · 1.7 m High tide 13:25 · 4.2 m 4.1 m

A tide's turn, written beside its mark: "Low tide 13:25 · 1.7 m". The mockup's drawTideRow and tideGlyph (design/chart/1-the-chart.html); no ui/ primitive yet.

Anatomy

  • Label: .wf-tide-label, an inline row: the turn's mark, then the words in mono medium at the caption step (11px; the mockup's 9.5, raised to the floor for sentence case), tabular, on a paper halo (a text-shadow of sem.color.ground).
  • Mark: __mark holding __dot, r 2.6. High water is an ink dot (--high on the label, or __dot--high in SVG); low water is a paper dot ringed in ink.
  • Curve: __curve, the dock's 40px tide row as SVG. __sea fills under the level in sem.color.sea; __level strokes it in sem.color.depth at 1.4; a __dot sits on each turn with __text beside it (below a high, above a low, anchored left unless it would run off the end); __now is a 3.4 dot in sem.color.chart-magenta at the present hour. In SVG the halo is a paper stroke painted under the letters (paint-order: stroke).
  • Line: --line, the popup's tide: __wave (a 14 by 8 wave, M0 5 Q3.5 0 7 4 T14 3, in sem.color.depth at 1.3) and "4.1 m" in mono at the body step.

Variants

  • --low and --high: which turn the label names.
  • --line: the popup's one line, no halo.

States

  • None. The curve's present-hour dot moves with the time the map is set to.

Usage

  • On the dock's tide row, one label per turn of the tide in the day's hours; on the spot page, the same marks on the day's curve, with the times and heights in a ruled table below.
  • The words are figures: "High tide 13:25 · 4.2 m". No "approximately", no sentence.
  • The magenta dot is the present hour on the curve, the chart's one magenta mark in the dock's tide row.
  • With no tide station near, say so in the body face's italic instead of drawing a flat line.

Accessibility

  • The HTML label is text, read as written.
  • The curve carries role="img" and an aria-label listing its turns and the present height: "Tide: low 07:05 2.2 m, high 13:25 4.2 m, low 20:10 1.7 m; now 3.6 m".
  • The popup's line is role="img" with "Tide 4.1 m"; the wave is decoration.
  • High and low are told apart by shape (filled and open) and by the word, not by colour.
components/tide-label/component.css
/* Tide label — a tide's turn, written beside its mark on the curve: the mockup's
 * drawTideRow and tideGlyph (design/chart/1-the-chart.html). No ui/ primitive
 * yet; drawn as the signed-off mockup draws it. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 *   .wf-tide-label           "Low tide 13:25 · 1.7 m" as HTML: the turn's mark,
 *                            then the words in mono 500 at the caption step
 *                            (the mockup's 9.5px; 11px is the floor for
 *                            sentence case), on a paper halo.
 *   .wf-tide-label__curve    the same on the dock's tide row, as SVG: the curve
 *                            in depth over a sea fill, a mark at each turn, the
 *                            words beside it, a magenta dot at the present hour.
 *   .wf-tide-label--line     the popup's line: a small wave in depth, "4.1 m".
 *
 * A turn's mark: high water an ink dot, low water a paper dot ringed in ink. */

.wf-tide-label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
  /* The halo: paper round the letters, so they read over the curve. */
  text-shadow:
    0 0 2px var(--sem-color-ground),
    0 0 3px var(--sem-color-ground),
    0 0 4px var(--sem-color-ground);
}

/* ---- the turn's mark: r 2.6 on the curve ---- */
.wf-tide-label__mark {
  display: inline-block;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  height: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  overflow: visible;
}
.wf-tide-label__dot {
  fill: var(--sem-color-card);
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
  stroke-width: 1;
}
.wf-tide-label--high .wf-tide-label__dot,
.wf-tide-label__dot--high {
  fill: var(--sem-color-inverse);
}

/* ---- the curve, on the dock's tide row ---- */
.wf-tide-label__curve {
  display: block;
  overflow: visible;
}
.wf-tide-label__sea {
  fill: var(--sem-color-sea);
}
.wf-tide-label__level {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-depth);
  stroke-width: 1.4;
}
/* The words in SVG: the halo is a paper stroke painted under the fill. */
.wf-tide-label__text {
  fill: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  paint-order: stroke;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-ground);
  stroke-width: 3px;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}
/* The present hour on the curve: the chart's magenta, once. */
.wf-tide-label__now {
  fill: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
}

/* ---- --line: the popup's tide, a wave and a figure ---- */
.wf-tide-label--line {
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
  text-shadow: none;
}
.wf-tide-label__wave {
  display: inline-block;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 3.5);
  height: var(--sem-space-x2);
}
.wf-tide-label__wave-path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--sem-color-depth);
  stroke-width: 1.3;
}

Wind figure

1221WSW 1119SW 1319N

14g22 13g21 8g15 14g22

Wind figure · night chart (proposed)

1221WSW 1526WSW 14g22
13g26W·6.5 m

The wind and its gust, as the site writes them: 12²¹ ↗ WSW on the spot page, 14 g22 in the dock, → 13 g26 W · 6.5 m in the popup. It is ui/Figure.tsx (value, sup, unit, alarm) with the mockup's downwind arrow and compass point beside it.

Anatomy

  • Container: .wf-wind-figure, an inline flex row in mono with tabular digits, baseline-aligned, sem.space.x0-5 apart (Figure's gap-0.5).
  • __value: the mean knots. Figure size md: the figure step (19, semibold, tracked -0.02em).
  • __sup: the gust, raised (aligned to the top) at the caption step, medium, ink-muted. Figure's sup.
  • __unit: a small word after a figure at caption, ink-muted.
  • __dir: the downwind arrow (__arrow, the mockup's arrowSVG on viewBox -7 -7 14 14, turned by rotate(calc(var(--from) + 180deg)), ink at 1.3) and __point, the compass point at the eyebrow step in ink-muted (capitals only, so the 10px floor holds).
  • __gust: the dock's and popup's "g22", written on the line, not raised.
  • __wing, __sep: the popup's wing figure and its "·".

Variants

  • Row (default): the spot page's wind cell. 12 at the figure step, 21 raised, then the arrow (16px) and "WSW".
  • --alarm: the gust is a big jump over the mean. The raised figure turns to sem.color.pen-ink and semibold (Figure's alarm): weight and colour together.
  • --cell: the dock's WIND row. The knots at the body step, semibold (Figure size sm; the mockup's 12.5px), then "g22" at the caption step in ink-muted (the mockup's 9.5px; 11 is the floor for lower case), a sem.space.x1 apart.
  • --line: the popup's wind line. Mono at the body step (the mockup's 12.5): the arrow (13px), the knots semibold, "g26", the compass point, the shore-wind glyph (.wf-shore-compass--wind), "·", the wing semibold and " m", sem.space.x1-5 apart.
  • --inverse: on an ink fill, every part in sem.color.ink-inverse.

States

  • None of its own. In the dock the cell takes the column's state (past, selected, night) from hour-cell.

Usage

  • Write wind as figures: 14 g22 · WSW · 6 m, never a sentence.
  • The gust goes raised (row) where a figure leads a row, and on the line ("g22") where space is tight or the line is read left to right.
  • Alarm only for a gust well over the mean; it is the pen's colour, so it counts towards a view's one or two pen marks.
  • The arrow always points downwind (where the wind goes), as on the map.
  • The --line form needs components/shore-compass/component.css loaded for its shore glyph.

Accessibility

  • The figure carries role="img" and an aria-label in words: "13 knots gusting 26 from the west"; the dock cell "14 knots gusting 22"; the popup line adds the shore and wing: "13 knots gusting 26 from the west, cross-offshore, 6.5 m wing".
  • The arrow is aria-hidden; the compass point is spelt out in the label ("west-south-west"), not read as letters.
  • Contrast: ink-muted gust 5.8:1, pen-ink alarm 4.9:1 on paper.
components/wind-figure/component.css
/* Wind figure — the wind and its gust as the site writes them. No ui/ primitive
 * of its own: it is ui/Figure.tsx (figureStyles: value, sup, unit, alarm) with
 * the mockup's downwind arrow (arrowSVG) and compass point beside it, in the
 * three places the mockup writes it (design/chart/1-the-chart.html):
 *
 *   row  (the default, the spot page's `.ht td.w`): 12²¹ ↗ WSW. The mean at
 *        the figure step, the gust raised small after it (Figure size md).
 *   --cell (the dock's `.tt tr.wd`): 14 g22. The knots at body semibold
 *        (Figure size sm), "g22" at the caption step, muted.
 *   --line (the popup's `.pp .ln`): → 13 g26 W [shore] · 6.5 m. One line of
 *        mono at the body step, the knots and the wing set semibold.
 *
 * The wind's direction is an inline custom property, not a colour:
 * style="--from: 270deg" (where it blows from); the arrow points downwind.
 * Consumes --sem-* only. */

.wf-wind-figure {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ---- Figure's parts ---- */
/* The mean: Figure md, the figure step. */
.wf-wind-figure__value {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-figure);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-figure);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-figure);
  letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-figure);
}
/* The gust raised over it. */
.wf-wind-figure__sup {
  align-self: flex-start;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
}
/* A unit or a quiet word after a figure: kn, m. */
.wf-wind-figure__unit {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
}
/* Alarm: the gust is a big jump over the mean. Pen's words, and heavier. */
.wf-wind-figure--alarm .wf-wind-figure__sup {
  color: var(--sem-color-pen-ink);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
}

/* ---- the direction: an arrow blowing downwind, the point it comes from ---- */
.wf-wind-figure__dir {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
  align-self: center;
  margin-left: var(--sem-space-x2);
}
.wf-wind-figure__arrow {
  display: inline-block;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: var(--sem-space-x4);
  height: var(--sem-space-x4);
  overflow: visible;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.wf-wind-figure__arrow-turn {
  transform: rotate(calc(var(--from, 0deg) + 180deg));
}
.wf-wind-figure__arrow-path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.3;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}
/* The compass point, small and muted: a label in capitals, so the eyebrow step. */
.wf-wind-figure__point {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-eyebrow);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-eyebrow);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
}

/* ---- --cell: the dock's 14 g22 ---- */
.wf-wind-figure--cell {
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
}
.wf-wind-figure--cell .wf-wind-figure__value {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
.wf-wind-figure__gust {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
}
/* On an ink fill (a selected cell): the paper's words. */
.wf-wind-figure--inverse,
.wf-wind-figure--inverse .wf-wind-figure__gust,
.wf-wind-figure--inverse .wf-wind-figure__sup,
.wf-wind-figure--inverse .wf-wind-figure__point {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-inverse);
}

/* ---- --line: the popup's one line ---- */
.wf-wind-figure--line {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
}
.wf-wind-figure--line .wf-wind-figure__value,
.wf-wind-figure__wing {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
  line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}
.wf-wind-figure--line .wf-wind-figure__gust {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-size: inherit;
  line-height: inherit;
}
.wf-wind-figure--line .wf-wind-figure__point {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
  font-size: inherit;
  line-height: inherit;
}
.wf-wind-figure--line .wf-wind-figure__arrow {
  width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 3.25);
  height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 3.25);
}
.wf-wind-figure__sep {
  color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
}

Wordmark

Wordmark

lg · 44 · the menu's head, an about page

wingfoil.ie

md · 30 · a masthead with the room (default)

wingfoil.ie

sm · 19 · a masthead on a phone, the map's top bar

wingfoil.ie

On the chart · sm

wingfoil.ie

Wordmark · night chart (proposed)

wingfoil.ie wingfoil.ie wingfoil.ie

The nameplate (ui/Wordmark.tsx, wordmarkStyles): "wingfoil" heavy and set tight in Fraunces at its display cut, then ".ie" in the light italic and the chart's magenta. Words, not a picture, so it is read as the name it is.

Anatomy

  • Container: .wf-wordmark — an inline-block in sem.font.family.display, sem.font.weight.extrabold (800, the wordmark's alone), line height 1, tracked sem.font.tracking.headline, never wrapping, in sem.color.ink. Fraunces is held at its largest optical size ("opsz" 144, the theme's optical-display) whatever size it is drawn at.
  • Domain: .wf-wordmark__domain — ".ie" in sem.font.weight.normal italic, untracked, in sem.color.chart-magenta.

Variants

  • --sm — sem.font.size.lead (19): a masthead on a phone, the map's top bar.
  • --md — sem.font.size.title (30), the default: a masthead with the room.
  • --lg — sem.font.size.headline (44): the menu's head, an about page.

States

  • None of its own. It is not pressable; the link round it carries the focus ring (see Masthead).

Usage

  • One a view. It is the magenta's one standing use besides the focus ring and the best of something; do not set anything else this heavy.
  • Write it as text with the domain in its own span, exactly wingfoil<span class="wf-wordmark__domain">.ie</span>; never an image.
  • In a masthead it carries .wf-masthead__mark, which steps it to lead under 720px.

Accessibility

  • Read as the words "wingfoil.ie". A link round it names where it goes, for example aria-label="wingfoil.ie Market, home".
  • Magenta on paper is 5.7:1; the ink is 14.6:1.
components/wordmark/component.css
/* Wordmark — ui/Wordmark.tsx (wordmarkStyles), rendered in CSS. Consumes --sem-* only.
 *
 * The nameplate: "wingfoil" in Fraunces at its display cut (the theme's
 * `optical-display`, opsz 144, whatever size it is drawn at), extrabold and
 * set tight, then ".ie" in the light italic and the chart's magenta. It is the
 * only thing on the site set this heavy. Words, not a picture. */

.wf-wordmark {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: var(--sem-font-family-display);
  /* md (title) is the default size; the explicit weight, leading and
     tracking below win over the step's own, as the recipe's utilities do. */
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-title);
  line-height: 1;
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-extrabold);
  /* tracking-tight on display type */
  letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-headline);
  font-variation-settings: "opsz" 144;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--sem-color-ink);
}

/* ---- sizes ---- */
/* A masthead on a phone, and the map's top bar. */
.wf-wordmark--sm {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
}
/* A masthead with the room (the default). */
.wf-wordmark--md {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-title);
}
/* The menu's head, an about page. */
.wf-wordmark--lg {
  font-size: var(--sem-font-size-headline);
}

/* ---- the domain: light italic, untracked, in the chart's magenta ---- */
.wf-wordmark__domain {
  font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-normal);
  font-style: italic;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
}

patterns/dock.html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Dock — wingfoil-chart pattern</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/button/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/segmented/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/kicker/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/star-glyphs/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/shore-compass/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/wind-figure/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/hour-cell/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/tide-label/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/pen-loop/component.css" />
    <style>
      /* The page: one sheet of paper with its grain; a mono label names each instance. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background-color: var(--sem-color-ground);
        background-image: var(--sem-texture-grain);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .pt__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x5) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-eyebrow);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-eyebrow);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-eyebrow);
        letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-eyebrow);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      /* A sea-tinted stand-in for the chart under what is laid over it. */
      .pt__map {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea-3);
      }
      /* The favourite: the glyph in the pen, filled when it is starred. */
      .fav {
        display: block;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
      }
      .fav__path {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-pen);
        stroke-width: 1.3;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      [aria-pressed="true"] > .fav .fav__path {
        fill: var(--sem-color-pen);
      }

      /* ---- the dock: paper along the foot of the map, a double rule along its top ---- */
      .dock__map {
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 24);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea-3);
      }
      .dock {
        position: relative;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        /* The double rule runs along one edge: every side zeroed first. */
        border: 0 double var(--sem-color-ink);
        border-top-width: var(--sem-rule-double);
        background-color: var(--sem-color-ground);
        background-image: var(--sem-texture-grain);
        box-shadow: var(--sem-shadow-dock);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
      }

      /* The phone's handle: pull the hours up. */
      .dock__grab {
        position: relative;
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        height: var(--sem-space-x5);
        padding: 0;
        border: 0;
        background: none;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .dock__grab::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 1.75);
        left: 50%;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 11);
        height: var(--sem-space-x1);
        margin-left: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * -5.5);
        border-radius: var(--sem-radius-full);
        background: var(--sem-color-line-strong);
      }
      .dock__grab:focus-visible {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: calc(var(--sem-ring-offset) * -1);
      }

      /* ---- the head: star, name, compass, then the switch and the one filled action ---- */
      .dock__head {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1) var(--sem-space-x2);
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .dock__head > .wf-button--worded {
        margin-left: calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) * -1);
      }
      .dock__name {
        min-width: 0;
        margin: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-display);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-lead);
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .dock__county {
        display: none;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      /* On a phone the verdict takes a line of its own, under the switch. */
      .dock__best {
        order: 4;
        flex-basis: 100%;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .dock__acts {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        width: 100%;
      }

      /* ---- the week: five days, each a strip of fourteen hours tinted by their stars ---- */
      .dock__week {
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
        border-top: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-ink);
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-ink);
        cursor: ew-resize;
        touch-action: none;
      }
      .dock__week:focus-visible {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
      }
      .dock__days {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }
      .dock__day {
        --pad: var(--sem-space-x1);
        position: relative;
        min-width: 0;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1) var(--pad);
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .dock__day:first-child {
        border-left: 0;
      }
      .dock__day--on {
        background-color: var(--sem-color-sunken);
      }
      .dock__dh {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
        height: var(--sem-space-x5);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .dock__dn {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-display);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .dock__dt,
      .dock__bw {
        display: none;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-eyebrow);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-eyebrow);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .dock__dst {
        display: none;
        margin-left: auto;
      }
      /* The phone says a day's best in a figure: 5★. */
      .dock__sn {
        margin-left: auto;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-eyebrow);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-eyebrow);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .dock__strip {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(14, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: var(--sem-rule-hairline);
        height: var(--sem-space-x2-5);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
      }
      /* An hour: faint ink when it has no stars, the chart's magenta by its stars. */
      .dock__h {
        display: block;
        background-color: var(--sem-color-hatch);
        opacity: var(--o, 1);
      }
      .dock__h--s1 { --o: var(--sem-opacity-strip-1); background-color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta); }
      .dock__h--s2 { --o: var(--sem-opacity-strip-2); background-color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta); }
      .dock__h--s3 { --o: var(--sem-opacity-strip-3); background-color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta); }
      .dock__h--s4 { --o: var(--sem-opacity-strip-4); background-color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta); }
      .dock__h--s5 { --o: var(--sem-opacity-strip-5); background-color: var(--sem-color-chart-magenta); }
      /* The dark hours: hatched, never rated. */
      .dock__h--night {
        background-color: transparent;
        background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sem-color-line) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px);
      }
      .dock__h--past {
        opacity: calc(var(--o, 1) * var(--sem-opacity-past));
      }
      /* The hand: an ink line at the hour shown, a notch at its head, the time on a flag. */
      .dock__hand {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        left: calc(var(--pad) + (100% - 2 * var(--pad)) * 6.5 / 14);
        width: 0;
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-heavy) solid var(--sem-color-ink);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .dock__hand::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(var(--sem-space-x1) * -1);
        left: calc(var(--sem-rule-heavy) / -2 - var(--sem-space-step) * 1.25);
        border: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 1.25) solid transparent;
        border-top-color: var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .dock__flag {
        position: absolute;
        bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline);
        left: var(--sem-space-x1);
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x1);
        background: var(--sem-color-inverse);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-inverse);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-eyebrow);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-eyebrow);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      /* ---- the hours: the hour-cell table, the pen's loop round the best run ---- */
      .dock__hours {
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x0-5);
      }
      .dock__loop {
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(var(--sem-space-x3) * -1);
        left: calc(var(--sem-space-x3) * -1);
        z-index: 2;
        overflow: visible;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .dock__loop--wide {
        display: none;
      }

      /* The tide row: the curve laid out in hours' columns, so it keeps to the table. */
      .dock__tide-cell {
        height: var(--sem-space-x10);
        padding: 0;
      }
      .dock__tide-plot {
        position: relative;
        width: calc(var(--wf-hour-cell-w) * 10);
        height: var(--sem-space-x10);
      }
      .dock__tide-curve {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        overflow: visible;
      }
      .dock__tide-day {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        left: calc(var(--wf-hour-cell-w) * 9);
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-heavy) solid var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .dock__turn {
        position: absolute;
        left: calc(var(--wf-hour-cell-w) * var(--x));
        transform: translate(calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) / -2), -50%);
      }
      .dock__turn--end {
        flex-direction: row-reverse;
        transform: translate(calc(-100% + var(--sem-space-x1-5) / 2), -50%);
      }
      .dock__tide-cursor {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        left: calc(var(--wf-hour-cell-w) * 1.5);
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-heavy) solid var(--sem-color-pen);
        opacity: var(--sem-opacity-pen);
      }
      .dock__tide-now {
        position: absolute;
        left: calc(var(--wf-hour-cell-w) * 1.5 + var(--sem-rule-heavy) / 2);
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 1.75);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 1.75);
        overflow: visible;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      }

      /* ---- from sem.breakpoint.wide (45rem): one line of head, the days in full ---- */
      @media (min-width: 720px) {
        .dock__map {
          height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 16);
        }
        .dock {
          padding: var(--sem-space-x1-5) var(--sem-space-x6) var(--sem-space-x2);
        }
        .dock__grab {
          display: none;
        }
        .dock__head {
          flex-wrap: nowrap;
        }
        .dock__county {
          display: inline;
        }
        .dock__best {
          order: 0;
          flex-basis: auto;
          margin-left: var(--sem-space-x2-5);
          padding-left: var(--sem-space-x3);
          border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        }
        .dock__acts {
          flex: none;
          width: auto;
          margin-left: auto;
          justify-content: flex-end;
        }
        .dock__day {
          --pad: var(--sem-space-x2);
        }
        .dock__dt,
        .dock__bw,
        .dock__dst {
          display: inline-flex;
        }
        .dock__sn {
          display: none;
        }
        .dock__loop--phone {
          display: none;
        }
        .dock__loop--wide {
          display: block;
        }
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Listing card — wingfoil-chart pattern</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/pane/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/kicker/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/chip/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/figure/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/star-glyphs/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/pen-loop/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/pen-note/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/pen-strike/component.css" />
    <style>
      /* The page: one sheet of paper with its grain; a mono label names each instance. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background-color: var(--sem-color-ground);
        background-image: var(--sem-texture-grain);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .pt__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x5) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-eyebrow);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-eyebrow);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-eyebrow);
        letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-eyebrow);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      /* A sea-tinted stand-in for the chart under what is laid over it. */
      .pt__map {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea-3);
      }
      /* The favourite: the glyph in the pen, filled when it is starred. */
      .fav {
        display: block;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
      }
      .fav__path {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-pen);
        stroke-width: 1.3;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      [aria-pressed="true"] > .fav .fav__path {
        fill: var(--sem-color-pen);
      }

      /* ---- the classifieds: two columns on a phone, as many 240px ones as fit wider ---- */
      .lc-grid {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: var(--sem-space-x6) var(--sem-space-x3);
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x8);
      }

      /* ---- a card: a ruled pane, a heavy rule over the ad and no box round it ---- */
      .lc {
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        min-width: 0;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        text-decoration: none;
      }
      .lc:focus-visible {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
      }
      .lc__kicker {
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .lc__where {
        overflow: hidden;
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }

      /* The photograph on the second sheet, in a hairline frame. */
      .lc__media {
        position: relative;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
        overflow: hidden;
        border: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        background-color: var(--sem-color-sunken);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      /* No photograph ships with the bundle: a stand-in of shore and sea in the chart's tints. */
      .lc__photo {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background-image: linear-gradient(175deg, var(--sem-color-land) 0%, var(--sem-color-sea-2) 45%, var(--sem-color-depth) 100%);
        transition: transform var(--sem-duration-base);
      }
      .lc__photo--2 {
        background-image: linear-gradient(175deg, var(--sem-color-sea-3) 0%, var(--sem-color-depth) 100%);
      }
      .lc__photo--3 {
        background-image: linear-gradient(175deg, var(--sem-color-sea-1) 0%, var(--sem-color-depth) 100%);
      }
      .lc__photo::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-35deg, var(--sem-color-ground) 0 1px, transparent 1px var(--sem-space-x5));
        opacity: var(--sem-opacity-dot);
      }
      /* Sold is said by the badge as well as by the colour draining out of it. */
      .lc--sold .lc__photo {
        filter: grayscale(1);
      }
      .lc__nophoto {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .lc__icon {
        width: var(--sem-space-x6);
        height: var(--sem-space-x6);
      }
      .lc__badge {
        position: absolute;
        top: var(--sem-space-x2);
        left: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }
      .lc__count {
        position: absolute;
        right: var(--sem-space-x2);
        bottom: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }

      .lc__body {
        display: flex;
        flex: 1;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
      }
      /* The price, and the pen's "new" a loop's reach off it. */
      .lc__head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x5);
        min-height: var(--sem-space-x7);
      }
      .lc__fresh {
        display: inline-block;
      }
      .lc__title {
        display: -webkit-box;
        margin: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-display);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-tight);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
        text-wrap: balance;
        text-decoration-thickness: var(--sem-rule-hairline);
        /* underline-offset-3 is Tailwind's 3px; no token holds it (Link records the gap). */
        text-underline-offset: 3px;
        -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
        -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      }
      .lc__meta {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        min-width: 0;
        margin-top: auto;
        padding-top: var(--sem-space-x1);
      }
      .lc__condition {
        overflow: hidden;
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .lc__sr {
        position: absolute;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        clip-path: inset(50%);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      /* Under the pointer the name underlines and the photograph leans in; nothing lifts. */
      .lc:hover .lc__title,
      .lc.is-hover .lc__title {
        text-decoration-line: underline;
      }
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
        .lc:hover .lc__photo,
        .lc.is-hover .lc__photo {
          transform: scale(1.04);
        }
      }

      /* ---- from sem.breakpoint.wide (45rem) ---- */
      @media (min-width: 720px) {
        .lc-grid {
          grid-template-columns: var(--sem-grid-cards);
          gap: var(--sem-space-x8) var(--sem-space-x6);
          padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x6) var(--sem-space-x10);
        }
      }
    </style>
  </head>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Spot day — wingfoil-chart pattern</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/button/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/section-heading/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/star-glyphs/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/shore-compass/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/wind-figure/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/figure/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/tide-label/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/kicker/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/pen-loop/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/pen-note/component.css" />
    <style>
      /* The page: one sheet of paper with its grain; a mono label names each instance. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background-color: var(--sem-color-ground);
        background-image: var(--sem-texture-grain);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .pt__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x5) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-eyebrow);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-eyebrow);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-eyebrow);
        letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-eyebrow);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      /* A sea-tinted stand-in for the chart under what is laid over it. */
      .pt__map {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea-3);
      }
      /* The favourite: the glyph in the pen, filled when it is starred. */
      .fav {
        display: block;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
      }
      .fav__path {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-pen);
        stroke-width: 1.3;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      [aria-pressed="true"] > .fav .fav__path {
        fill: var(--sem-color-pen);
      }

      /* ---- the day: a section under a heavy rule, no box ---- */
      .sd {
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x4) var(--sem-space-x8);
      }
      .sd__head {
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 4;
        padding-top: var(--sem-space-x2);
        background-color: var(--sem-color-ground);
        background-image: var(--sem-texture-grain);
      }
      .sd__h1 {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2-5);
      }
      .sd__best {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .sd__wk {
        display: inline-block;
        transform: rotate(-2deg);
      }
      /* On a phone the note takes its own line under the head. */
      .sd__pn {
        flex-basis: 100%;
      }

      /* ---- the hours: one row each, ruled in hairlines ---- */
      .sd__wrap {
        position: relative;
      }
      .sd__rows {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        table-layout: fixed;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .sd__rows th {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1) var(--sem-space-x0-5);
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-ink);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-eyebrow);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-eyebrow);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-eyebrow);
        letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-eyebrow);
        text-align: left;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        white-space: nowrap;
        vertical-align: bottom;
      }
      /* The ? in a column head: the quiet icon button, drawn small in the head's line. */
      .sd__rows th .wf-button--icon {
        width: var(--sem-space-x5);
        height: var(--sem-space-x5);
        margin: calc(var(--sem-space-x1) * -1) 0;
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      .sd__g {
        text-transform: none;
      }
      .sd__c-t { width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 7.5); }
      .sd__c-st { width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 16.5); }
      .sd__c-w { width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 17); }
      .sd__c-sh { width: var(--sem-space-x10); }
      .sd__c-wg { width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 13); }
      .sd__c-wx { width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 14.5); }
      .sd__rows td {
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 9.5);
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x0-5);
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        white-space: nowrap;
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      .sd__row {
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .sd__row:hover td {
        background-color: var(--sem-color-sunken);
      }
      .sd__row:focus-visible {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: calc(var(--sem-ring-offset) * -1);
      }
      /* The hour on the chart: the second sheet, an edge of ink at its head. */
      .sd__row--sel td {
        background-color: var(--sem-color-sunken);
      }
      .sd__row--sel .sd__t {
        box-shadow: inset var(--sem-rule-edge) 0 0 var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .sd__row--past td {
        opacity: var(--sem-opacity-past);
      }
      .sd__t {
        position: relative;
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .sd__row--sel .sd__t {
        padding-left: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
      }
      .sd__from {
        align-items: center;
      }
      .sd__waves,
      .sd__u {
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      .sd__waves {
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .sd__sky {
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.5);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.5);
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      .sd__sky-cloud,
      .sd__sky-sun {
        fill: var(--sem-color-card);
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 1.1;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      .sd__sky-ray {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 1.1;
        stroke-linecap: round;
      }
      .sd__air {
        margin-left: var(--sem-space-x1);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        vertical-align: middle;
      }
      .sd__wide {
        display: none;
      }
      .sd__loop {
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(var(--sem-space-x2) * -1);
        left: calc(var(--sem-space-x3) * -1);
        z-index: 2;
        overflow: visible;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .sd__loop--wide {
        display: none;
      }

      /* ---- the tide over the day: night hatched, the turns marked, the hour shown in magenta ---- */
      .sd__tide {
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x4);
      }
      .sd__plot {
        position: relative;
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 16);
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line-strong);
      }
      .sd__curve {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
      }
      .sd__night {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--sem-color-line) 0 1px, transparent 1px 4px);
      }
      .sd__night--twilight {
        opacity: var(--sem-opacity-faded);
      }
      .sd__now {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-chart-magenta);
      }
      .sd__turn {
        position: absolute;
        transform: translate(calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) / -2), -50%);
      }
      .sd__axis {
        position: relative;
        height: var(--sem-space-x5);
      }
      .sd__tick {
        position: absolute;
        top: var(--sem-space-x1);
        transform: translateX(-50%);
      }
      .sd__tick::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(var(--sem-space-x1) * -1);
        left: 50%;
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 0.75);
        border-left: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line-strong);
      }
      .sd__tick:first-child {
        transform: none;
      }
      .sd__tick:first-child::before {
        left: 0;
      }
      .sd__tick:last-child {
        transform: translateX(-100%);
      }
      .sd__tick:last-child::before {
        left: auto;
        right: 0;
      }

      /* ---- the turns and the light: two small tables on the second sheet ---- */
      .sd__tabs {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        gap: var(--sem-space-x4);
        max-width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 140);
      }
      .sd__mini {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
      }
      .sd__mini td {
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1);
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        background-color: var(--sem-color-sunken);
      }
      .sd__n {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        text-align: right;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .sd__sr {
        position: absolute;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        clip-path: inset(50%);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }

      /* ---- from sem.breakpoint.wide (45rem): the shore, wing and waves come in ---- */
      @media (min-width: 720px) {
        /* Every column keeps its width; the waves take what is left over. */
        .sd {
          max-width: var(--sem-container-form);
          padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x8) var(--sem-space-x10);
        }
        .sd__pn {
          flex-basis: auto;
        }
        .sd__wide {
          display: table-cell;
        }
        .sd__c-dr {
          width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 20);
        }
        .sd__rows td {
          height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 8.5);
        }
        .sd__loop--phone {
          display: none;
        }
        .sd__loop--wide {
          display: block;
        }
      }
    </style>
  </head>

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
    <title>Spot popup — wingfoil-chart pattern</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../foundations/tokens.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/button/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/surface/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/kicker/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/star-glyphs/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/shore-compass/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/wind-figure/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/tide-label/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/spot-light/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/pen-loop/component.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../components/pen-note/component.css" />
    <style>
      /* The page: one sheet of paper with its grain; a mono label names each instance. */
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background-color: var(--sem-color-ground);
        background-image: var(--sem-texture-grain);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-body);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-prose);
      }
      .pt__label {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x5) var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x2);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-eyebrow);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-eyebrow);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-eyebrow);
        letter-spacing: var(--sem-font-tracking-eyebrow);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
      }
      /* A sea-tinted stand-in for the chart under what is laid over it. */
      .pt__map {
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3);
        background: var(--sem-color-sea-3);
      }
      /* The favourite: the glyph in the pen, filled when it is starred. */
      .fav {
        display: block;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
        height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 4.25);
      }
      .fav__path {
        fill: none;
        stroke: var(--sem-color-pen);
        stroke-width: 1.3;
        stroke-linejoin: round;
      }
      [aria-pressed="true"] > .fav .fav__path {
        fill: var(--sem-color-pen);
      }

      /* ---- the chart under it: sea, a coast, the other lights gone quiet ---- */
      .pop__map {
        min-height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 110);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x10) var(--sem-space-x3) 0;
      }
      .pop__land {
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
      }
      .pop__coast {
        fill: var(--sem-color-land);
        stroke: var(--sem-color-ink);
        stroke-width: 1;
        vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
      }
      .pop__other {
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 92);
        left: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 22);
      }
      .pop__stack {
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
      }

      /* ---- the popup: the chart's box, with its tip down at the light ---- */
      .pop {
        position: relative;
        width: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 64);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x3) var(--sem-space-x4);
      }
      .pop::after {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(100% + var(--sem-rule-hairline));
        left: 50%;
        margin-left: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * -2.5);
        border: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 2.5) solid transparent;
        border-top-color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        border-bottom-width: 0;
      }
      .pop__head {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
      }
      .pop__head > .wf-button--worded {
        margin-left: calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) * -1);
      }
      .pop__head > .wf-button:last-child {
        align-self: flex-start;
        margin-right: calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) * -1);
      }
      .pop__name {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
        margin: 0;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-display);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-lead);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-lead);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-lead);
      }
      /* The county sits under the name, clear of the star. */
      .pop__meta {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        margin: 0 0 0 var(--sem-size-control-sm);
      }
      /* The hour: ruled in ink above, a hairline below. */
      .pop__row {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        margin: var(--sem-space-x2) 0 var(--sem-space-x1-5);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x0-5) 0;
        border-top: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-ink);
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .pop__when {
        margin-right: auto;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-label);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-label);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
      .pop__row > .wf-button:last-child {
        margin-right: calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) * -1);
      }
      .pop__ln {
        margin: var(--sem-space-x1) 0;
      }
      .pop__acts {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: flex-end;
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x2);
      }

      /* ---- the light it points at, the pen's loop round it and its note ---- */
      .pop__spot {
        position: relative;
        width: var(--sem-space-x5);
        height: var(--sem-space-x5);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x5);
      }
      .pop__loop {
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        left: 50%;
        overflow: visible;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        pointer-events: none;
      }
      .pop__note {
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(50% + var(--sem-space-x6));
        left: 50%;
        transform: translateX(-50%);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>

      <div class="pop__stack">

          <div class="pop__head">

        padding: var(--sem-space-x1-5) var(--sem-space-x4) var(--sem-space-x3);
      }
      /* The tabs: the chosen one italic, heavier and underlined in ink, never colour alone. */
      .ys__tabs {
        display: flex;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x4);
        margin: 0 0 var(--sem-space-x1);
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-ink);
      }
      .ys__tab {
        margin: 0 0 calc(var(--sem-rule-hairline) * -1);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1-5) 0 var(--sem-space-x1);
        border: 0;
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-heavy) solid transparent;
        background: none;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-display);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-tight);
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-medium);
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .ys__tab[aria-selected="true"] {
        border-bottom-color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink);
        font-style: italic;
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
      .ys__tab:focus-visible {
        outline: var(--sem-ring-width) solid var(--sem-color-focus);
        outline-offset: var(--sem-ring-offset);
      }
      .ys__when {
        align-self: center;
        margin-left: auto;
      }
      .ys__h {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        min-height: calc(var(--sem-space-step) * 6.5);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x1-5);
      }
      .ys__h > .wf-button {
        margin-right: calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) * -1);
      }
      .ys__list {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
      }
      .ys__row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: var(--sem-size-control-sm) minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0 var(--sem-space-x1);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1) 0;
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
      }
      .ys__row > .wf-button {
        margin-left: calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) * -1);
      }
      .ys__go {
        display: block;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .ys__name {
        display: block;
        overflow: hidden;
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-display);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-tight);
        font-style: italic;
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
        white-space: nowrap;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
      }
      .ys__line {
        display: block;
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .ys__none {
        margin: 0;
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1-5) 0;
        border-bottom: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-body);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-body);
        font-style: italic;
      }
      .ys__sign {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x2);
        margin-top: var(--sem-space-x2-5);
        color: var(--sem-color-ink-muted);
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-mono);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-caption);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-caption);
      }
      .ys__sign > .wf-button:last-child {
        margin-right: calc(var(--sem-space-x1-5) * -1);
      }

      /* ---- the phone's strip: the starred spots side by side, a label on its side ---- */
      .ys-strip {
        display: flex;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x1-5) var(--sem-space-x2);
        overflow-x: auto;
        scrollbar-width: none;
      }
      .ys-strip__best {
        flex: none;
        align-self: center;
        padding: 0 var(--sem-space-x0-5);
        transform: rotate(180deg);
        writing-mode: vertical-rl;
      }
      .ys-strip__list {
        display: flex;
        flex: none;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
      }
      .ys-strip__item {
        display: flex;
        flex: none;
        align-items: center;
        gap: var(--sem-space-x1);
        padding: var(--sem-space-x0-5) var(--sem-space-x2) var(--sem-space-x0-5) 0;
        border-right: var(--sem-rule-hairline) solid var(--sem-color-line);
        white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .ys-strip__item:last-child {
        border-right: 0;
      }
      .ys-strip__name {
        font-family: var(--sem-font-family-display);
        font-size: var(--sem-font-size-prose);
        line-height: var(--sem-font-line-tight);
        font-style: italic;
        font-weight: var(--sem-font-weight-semibold);
      }
    </style>
  </head>
